reasons: Draft claims '.NET 11, released in November 2026' and '.NET 10' as latest LTS; source infobox shows latest release .NET 10.0 with access-date 2026-10-05 and preview links, but no mention of .NET 11 or November 2026 release.

Draft states 'annual release cycles producing short-term support versions and longer-term support releases'; source only says 'New versions ... are released annually, typically in November' and mentions STS/LTS for .NET 11/10 but those versions are not verified in source.
Mechanism 'Managed code execution environment' cites source S1 but source text does not describe memory layout, type safety, or security sandboxing mechanisms.
Mechanism 'Cross-platform abstraction layer' cites source S1 but source text does not explain translation of platform-specific operations or decoupling from OS APIs.
Draft summary says 'runs on various CPU architectures including x86-64, ARM, and IBM Z'; source infobox lists IA-32, x86-64, ARM, Power ISA, s390x (IBM Z) but draft omits IA-32 and Power ISA.
